title: Sing to the Lord a New Song

questions.question: Oh sing to the Lord a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:1 (ESV): "Oh sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord, all the earth!"

questions.question: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:3 (ESV): "Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples!"

questions.question: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; he is to be feared above all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:4 (ESV): "For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; he is to be feared above all gods."

questions.question: For all the gods of the peoples are worthless idols, but the Lord made the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:5 (ESV): "...but the Lord made the heavens."

questions.question: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and beauty are in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:6 (ESV): "Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary."

questions.question: Ascribe to the Lord, O families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord glory and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:7 (ESV): "Ascribe to the Lord, O families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength!"

questions.question: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering, and come into his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:8 (ESV): "...bring an offering, and come into his courts!"

questions.question: Worship the Lord in the splendor of holiness; tremble before him, all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:9 (ESV): "...tremble before him, all the earth!"

questions.question: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns! Yes, the world is established; it shall never be what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:10 (ESV): "...Yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved;"

questions.question: He will judge the peoples with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:10 (ESV): "...he will judge the peoples with equity."

questions.question: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; let the sea roar, and all that fills it; let the field exult, and everything in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:11-12 (ESV): "...let the field exult, and everything in it!"

questions.question: Then shall all the trees of the forest sing for joy before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:12-13 (ESV): "Then shall all the trees of the forest sing for joy before the Lord,"

questions.question: For he comes, for he comes to judge the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:13 (ESV): "...for he comes to judge the earth."

questions.question: He will judge the world in righteousness, and the peoples in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96:13 (ESV): "...and the peoples in his faithfulness."

questions.question: This Psalm is similar to a portion of which book?
questions.explanation: Psalm 96 is largely found in 1 Chronicles 16:23-33.

key_verse_text: Oh sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord, all the earth! Sing to the Lord, bless his name; tell of his salvation from day to day.
